At Purdue University, we are persistent in our pursuit of the next giant leap.  

As a land-grant university and one of the nation’s leading public research universities, Purdue serves everyone through transformative education and engagement. With more than 150 undergraduate majors and renowned graduate and professional programs, Purdue offers opportunities across aerospace engineering, aviation, computer science, artificial intelligence, engineering, agriculture, business, healthcare and human sciences, liberal arts, education, technology and the sciences. 

Known as the Cradle of Astronauts, Purdue has played a pivotal role in advancing space exploration and STEM education. Together, Boilermakers are building solutions that improve lives around the world. 

Subscribe to never miss a new video on student stories, alumni achievements, campus traditions, research breakthroughs, faculty expertise, athletics, events and behind-the-scenes looks at life at Purdue.
